## What This Is

A new codex that catalogs the writing patterns that betray LLM authorship. Sixty patterns across eight categories: lexical blacklist, opener tells, hedging and padding, negation and pivot constructions, rhetorical reflexes, voice and register signatures, structural tics, formatting and visual tics. Each entry names the tell, gives a specimen sentence, names the RLHF training pressure that produces it, and gives an affirmative-voice replacement.

This codex is the negative space of the Sovereign's voice. The Writing Style Codex defines what the Sovereign sounds like. This codex defines what the Sovereign never sounds like. Both run simultaneously on any draft. The codex drives the editing pass over long-form prose where AI assistance touched the text. Primary targets: book manuscripts, ebooks, long-form digital products, multi-chapter playbooks.

The codex ships in template form. Personalization happens during onboarding via a Vocabulary Reconciliation pass that surfaces the Sovereign's natural vocabulary so genuine usage stays and AI-reflex usage gets flagged.

## What It Adds / Changes

### Adds Council Chamber/Codices/Expression/Anti-AI Writing Patterns Codex.md

New codex (template form, v1.0). Sections I through VIII cover the eight pattern categories. Section III names the RLHF Mechanism Layer so editors can predict where the same training pressure surfaces differently elsewhere. The Personalization Note at the end of the codex walks the Sovereign through the Vocabulary Reconciliation pass that converts the template into a sealed personalized codex.

### Adds to CLAUDE.md Expression Standards

One reference bullet linking to the new codex. The bullet names the codex as the negative-space companion to the Writing Style Codex and confirms that both run simultaneously on any draft.

## How to Implement

The AI Interface (Claude Code) executes the following steps from the working directory:

1. Create `Council Chamber/Codices/Expression/Anti-AI Writing Patterns Codex.md` with the template-form content. Frontmatter status is `template`.

2. Open `.claude/CLAUDE.md`. In the Expression Standards section, locate the Writing Style Codex reference bullet. Add the Anti-AI Writing Patterns Codex reference bullet immediately after. The new bullet names the codex as the negative-space companion.

3. The Sovereign schedules a Vocabulary Reconciliation pass when ready to seal the codex for their voice. The pass greps candidate banned words against the Sovereign's existing writing corpus, marks verified exceptions inline with `(SOVEREIGN-VOCAB RECONCILED)`, and adds the Sovereign's signature words to the affirmative-voice preserve list.

## Prerequisites

- v2.3.0 Operational Maturity (CLAUDE.md trust anchor hardening, where the Expression Standards block lives)
- An active Writing Style Codex (personalized or template) at `Council Chamber/Codices/Expression/Writing Style Codex.md`

## Optional?

No. The codex ships in template form to every ecosystem. The Vocabulary Reconciliation pass that personalizes it is a scheduled task the Sovereign owns.
